decisions.twoSeries: Original Series One 220 cards issued November 2003, Update Series 175 cards issued October 2004. Keep single collector checklist but never mix the update 175 into Series One packs.
decisions.factory: 2004 Ultra authentic first-series hobby/retail 8 cards/pack x24 box. Update retail 8x24, Update hobby 5x12. Product-level 8x24 reflects Series One ONLY; proper series-aware pack logic required to release.
decisions.base: All 395 original player identity/team/number entries independently checked against BCP and MCB. BCP flags individual RC candidates; identity-only source flags are NOT independently validated TCDB true RC status.
decisions.sourceDiscrepancies: BCP versus MCB player aliases #72 Jose Cruz/Jr, #276 Alexis/Alex Rios, #332 Luis A./Luis Gonzalez, #348 Mike/Michael Wuertz, #357 Don/Donnie Kelly, #383 Kaz/Kazuo Matsui. Final Lucky 13 L13 suffix preserved as subset, not treated as part of player name.
decisions.correction: MCB erroneously lists a 21st Turn Back the Clock Jersey card TBC-HM Hideo Nomo despite genuine source checklist only 20 including TBC-HN Hideo Nomo; omit unsupported TBC-HM from Copper, Silver and Gold; Platinum patch variation authentically uses TBC-HM in place of Copper/Gold/Silver TBC-HN.
decisions.coverage: 40 authentic TCDB insert and memorabilia groups (28 MCB source groups and 12 independently TCDB-confirmed variations) plus base and two actual parallel base families. Never invent players/numbers.
decisions.gold: All 395 Gold Medallion, correct series/SP frequencies; all 395 Platinum Medallion serial cap /66, /100, /13 per original numbered subset.
decisions.rarity: Preserve source serial caps, original exact team affiliations, swatch families, and print variations in each card variant notes; source discrepancies remain documentable.
decisions.odds: No invented integer group odds: guaranteed Gold, multi-series 8x24 vs 5x12, separately seeded SP slots, serials, blaster-only variants, unique memorabilia and series restrictions need dedicated collation engine.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft until source-accurate scans, authentic pack/box art, pricing and product-series collation are independently verified. No mutations to previous sets.
